race.comment: VICTIMISED (11) resumed in good order and finished a sound third as the favourite at Warrnambool 11 days ago. She has the draw to plant herself right on the speed, and with that fresh run out of the way, she will go close to taking this out. Stick with her. MISTRESSOF MAYFAIR (10) unraced 3yo filly who has trialled seven times. Impressive trial win on November 4 at Sandown-Hillside over 800m. Big watch. THUNDERING SHADOW (8) set the pace fresh up, and was only claimed late, finishing third by half a length. She has a superior gate this time, and can take them all the way this time. BLUE LIGHT DISCO (1) went close to winning a race in his initial campaign, and will have the aid of the pole position fresh up. With a pair of jump-outs under his belt, he will be ready to rumble fresh. COSTLY EXERCISE (2) has improved in each of his 3 jump-outs, and he is worth considering on debut, especially if there is any money for him.
